name: astro-theme-joblo
description: Joblo — a premium Astro 7 job-marketplace template with two homepages, full candidate + employer dashboards, verified companies, editorial blog, and structured-data SEO. Tailwind CSS 4, auto-inverting ink tokens, Instrument Serif italic accents, dark-mode first.

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push --tags
